location.site_description: Approximately 29.69 acres out of the Willis Donaho Jr. Survey, Abstract No. 173, on E. Old Settlers Blvd. near N. A.W. Grimes Blvd.; City PUD page describes the site as east of N. A.W. Grimes Boulevard and south of E. Old Settlers Boulevard.
location.possible_address: 2601 E. Old Settlers Blvd., Round Rock, TX 78665

status_as_of_cutoff: As of 2026-08-11, Round Rock PUD No. 159 / Ordinance file 2025-326 is approved for a proposed Skybox Old Settlers data center, but no accessible official building permit, Oncor service confirmation, construction start, energization, or live status was verified.
evidence_grade: official city land-use approval; construction/utility evidence unresolved

history.value: P&Z recommendation and City Council PUD ordinance approval are recorded in Round Rock Legistar; building permit, utility, and construction status remain unresolved.

actions.body: Round Rock Planning and Zoning Commission
actions.result_or_status: Commission action result is Pass/approve for rezoning approximately 29.69 acres from LI to Skybox Old Settlers PUD, Case PUD25-00009.
actions.access_caveat: Official Legistar action result; no tally was published on the accessible record.

actions.result_or_status: Second-reading Legistar text says the rezoning request was approved unanimously on first reading on December 4, 2025; the accessible Legistar history table still lists the result/tally as not available.
actions.vote_tally: unanimous per second-reading staff text; no numeric tally in accessible history table
actions.access_caveat: Official Legistar history; result is shown as Not available for the first reading.
actions.notes: Land-use action; do not infer passage from later second reading.

actions.action_type: PUD ordinance second reading / final action
actions.result_or_status: Legistar marks Ordinance file 2025-326 Approved and final action 2026-02-12, rezoning 29.69 acres to PUD No. 159 with the published development-plan limits.
actions.access_caveat: Official city legislation record; vote tally was not published in the accessible Legistar result.
actions.notes: Land-use action; approval does not prove a building permit or construction start.

actions.body: Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation
actions.action_type: TABS accessibility registration at possible project address
actions.result_or_status: TDLR project TABS2025018376 for 2601 E. Old Settlers Blvd. - Building 1 is named Old Settlers Industrial, lists Zydeco Development as owner, describes a 119,016-sf cold dark shell with no mechanical or interior electrical, and is marked Project Closed.
actions.access_caveat: Official state accessibility-registration record; it is not a city building permit and does not identify Skybox or a data-center use.
actions.notes: Construction-status caution for the same possible address; do not use as proof that the Skybox data center is permitted or under construction.

owner: Skybox Datacenters is the named project/developer in city public materials; P&Z records say Kimley-Horn filed the rezoning on behalf of property owner 2601 Old Settlers Ltd.; a same-address TDLR filing lists Zydeco Development for a separate/possibly pre-PUD industrial shell.

sources.match_reason: Exact Phase3↔regional stable-ID pair; seed merged only with explicit evidence

contradictions.summary: Same-address construction evidence conflicts with the Skybox data-center narrative: TDLR and Zydeco identify Old Settlers Industrial / Zydeco Development / cold dark shell industrial work at 2601 E. Old Settlers Blvd., while city land-use records approve Skybox Old Settlers PUD for a data center and possible substation. No accessible source ties the TDLR filing to a Skybox data-center building permit.
